description: Which task version existed before the cancellation deadline, quote expiry, or authorization boundary? Obtain a signed time witness for its exact SHA-256 digest and request nonce. Keep raw task content local. The time receipt records a checkpoint; use popcorn_time for fresh current time. Defaults to a no-payment x402 dry run. Payment requires approve_payment exactly true under the operator's spending policy and EVM_PRIVATE_KEY; maximum $0.001 USDC on Base. Does not prove identity, availability, authorization, or execution.

approve_payment.description: Must be exactly true to authorize one $0.001 payment.

digest.description: SHA-256 payload digest as canonical unpadded base64url.

nonce.description: Caller-generated 32-byte nonce as canonical unpadded base64url.

previous_attestation_digest.description: SHA-256 of the predecessor compact JWS decoded signed payload bytes, or null to start a chain.

name: popcorn_witness
title: Request a signed POPCORN payload witness
